author: agent
sentences: I upgraded my camera after years of filming on my phone.
The new body cost $2,400, and the lens was extra.
It is a 4K camera, but I still export most videos at a lower resolution.
The autofocus is *incredible* in low light.
If you film indoors, spend on lights before you spend on a camera.
notes: a dollar price; one emphasized word; a 4K camera names a resolution, not an amount, and is no event
